title: Medications
disclaimer: Record exactly what the veterinarian prescribed. The app never suggests medications, doses or diagnoses.

empty.title: No medications recorded
empty.body: Record what the veterinarian prescribed to get dose reminders.

list.viewerOnly: You can only view this pet's medications.

permission.title: Turn on notifications to get reminders
permission.body: Without permission, the app cannot tell you when a dose is due.
permission.unavailable: Reminders are not available in this version of the app. Update the app to receive them.

form.name: Medication name
form.doseAmountHint: As written in the prescription. Examples: 1, 1/2, 2.5
form.timesHint: Type a time (e.g. 08:00) and tap Add.
form.saveFailed: Could not save the medication. Please try again.
form.savePending: The server has not confirmed yet. The medication is saved on this device and will be sent when the connection is back.
form.reminderHint: You will get a reminder when each dose is due.

detail.title: Medication
detail.expired: Expired on {{date}}. Do not use it and talk to the veterinarian.
detail.treatmentOver: The treatment ended on {{date}}. Mark it as completed.
detail.logFailed: Could not record the dose. Please try again.
detail.logPending: Recorded on this device; it will be sent when the connection is back.
detail.deleteBody: The medication and its dose history will be erased. This cannot be undone.

ends_tomorrow.title: {{pet}}: treatment ends tomorrow
ends_tomorrow.body: Tomorrow is the last day of {{name}}.

ends_today.title: {{pet}}: last day of treatment
ends_today.body: Today is the last day of {{name}}.

expires_today.title: {{pet}}: medication expires today
expires_today.body: {{name}} expires today ({{date}}). Do not use it after the expiry date.

vaccine_tomorrow.title: {{pet}}: vaccine tomorrow
vaccine_tomorrow.body: Tomorrow is the planned date for: {{name}}.

vaccine_today.title: {{pet}}: vaccine today
vaccine_today.body: Today is the planned date for: {{name}}.

scan.title: Scan barcode
scan.hint: Point the camera at the barcode on the package.
scan.permissionBody: The camera is only used to read the medication's barcode. Nothing is recorded.
scan.unavailable: Camera scanning is not available in this version of the app. Type the code or update the app.
